verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's manifesto makes a first-party backwards-compatibility commitment, and its docs promise drop-in Terraform compatibility. Community reports of easy migration and of releases keeping Terraform compatibility support the cross-product side. However, the pack has no detailed compatibility policy between OpenTofu releases and no per-release upgrade guides. Missing for 10: documented version-to-version compatibility guarantees (e.g. a formal compatibility policy or semver rules), release upgrade guides or migration notes, and independent corroboration of smooth upgrades between OpenTofu releases.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on documented compatibility promises and upgrade guides between releases

citations.quote: Backwards-compatible - so that the existing code can drive value for years to come
It serves as a drop-in replacement for Terraform, preserving your existing workflows and configurations.
